scope: GNOME Wayland nested compositor capability probe under disposable Xvfb

commands.assertions: GNOME Shell 46.0/Mutter 46.2 launched under a nested X11 display, but Mutter reported that this backend does not support creating virtual monitors. The command exited without a usable Wayland monitor or desktop surface.

limitations: No Device Control helper journey was attempted because the compositor exposed no monitor, capture stream, input surface, or user session. This probe does not prove NAT-06 or the linux-x64-gnome-wayland support row; both remain not_run.
